exposure: patient having a sibling born preterm
partner's family history of premature delivery
outcome: spontaneous preterm delivery (PTD) in the present pregnancy
cohort: The study included 354 women who delivered between 2018 and 2020, with 177 cases of spontaneous preterm delivery matched with 177 controls who had full-term delivery.
finding: Pregnant patients who were born prematurely or who have siblings born preterm have an increased risk of preterm delivery in their own pregnancies.
